name: Malt stabilized pool credits treasury-injected DAI to the swapper
summary: Malt's MALT/DAI stabilized pool 0xfe6c096a (a Uniswap-v2-style pair with swap(uint256,uint256,address)) calls its stabilizer hook 0xf61ab339 before paying out a swap; below peg the hook has the swing trader 0x6f96483f move DAI from the Capital Source 0xf0d31484 into the pool to buy MALT, and swap() then checks the constant-product invariant against the pool's final balances, so the injected treasury DAI counts as the swapper's input while the swing trader receives almost nothing. With a 1,300 DAI Balancer flash loan the attacker bought MALT on QuickSwap, sold it into the pool to push it below peg, sent 1 DAI and requested 7,823.54 MALT; the hook injected 6,286.10 DAI of treasury funds and the pool released the MALT, which was sold back on QuickSwap. A second round injected 6,458.54 DAI for 8,229.25 MALT, and the attacker kept 13,440.58 DAI. Copycats repeated it over the following week.
notes: The pool, hook, swing trader and Capital Source are unverified; the mechanism is read from the anchor's trace, as in the PoC and SlowMist's alert. In every exploit transaction the swing trader's buy (0xcb323c23 on the pool) returned at most a few MALT for thousands of DAI while the caller's 1-DAI swap released tens of thousands of MALT.

Reset of the hook target is 0x847f2f4f (block 59331588, 2024-07-14), which pointed the pool's slot 6 from the previous hook 0xc21d6ac3 to 0xf61ab339; it is later than the pool's and swing trader's deployments (2024-06-04) and the swing trader's role grant to the new hook (block 59331375). Later writes to these contracts are reserves, price accumulators and swing-trader accounting.

No earlier exploit: all 28 earlier transactions moving Capital Source DAI into the pool (blocks 57896806-88742494) are ordinary stabilizations in which the swing trader received MALT at about the pool price (keeper 1-DAI pokes, or arbitrage bots whose MALT output matched their own DAI input under the constant product). The anchor is the first where the swing trader got nothing.

Campaign: four transactions by 0xfc3facd6 on 2026-10-03 (34,513, 9,595, 9,592 and 10,475 DAI injected), five by four other senders at blocks 94879141-94879143, and 0x584f5162's on 2026-10-10 (10,734 DAI). In 0x96910d12 and the five later 2026-10-03 transactions the attacker routed 6,600 or 10,300 DAI of its own through the swing trader back to the Capital Source; those deposits are netted within their transactions.

Loss is the Capital Source's DAI depletion per transaction over the campaign (loss.mjs with the Capital Source and swing trader as victims): 82,000.36 DAI. SlowMist's ~72k covers 2026-10-03 only (71,266.54 DAI); the 2026-10-10 transaction adds 10,733.81 DAI. The pool's own DAI/MALT reserve changes are trades at pool prices and are not counted.
